description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller that manages project documents, allowing uploads, downloads, and listing of documents related to projects. It handles file storage, metadata management, and security via role-based access control.

classes.name: DocumentController
classes.description: REST controller handling HTTP requests related to project documents, including upload, download, and listing.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file upload for a project, saving file to storage and metadata to repository, returns document metadata response.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Retrieves a document by its id and returns it as a downloadable resource with correct content type.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of document metadata for a specific project.
